text:
Lia: Hey team — since the v2.3 rollout our product's SKU list responses started including inconsistent quoting. Some items come back as `"SKU-123"`, others as `\`SKU-124\``. Happened right after the rollout. Example response pasted below.
Ana: Ugh, thanks for the heads up. Can you share the exact prompt you sent, the model name/version, and one request_id or timestamp? Also were you using streaming?
Lia: model: redwood-clarity-v2.3.0, streaming: true, occurred around 2026-03-15T14:23:07Z. Request id: req_7f9a2b3c. Prompt (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{\n  "model": "redwood-clarity-v2.3.0",\n  "input": "List SKUs for order 98234 as comma separated values",\n  "stream": true\n}
```
Lia: Expected: SKU-123, SKU-124, SKU-125
Actual (snippet): `"SKU-123", `SKU-124`, SKU-125
triage-bot: Ticket created: CS-4321 — severity: P2 — assigned to customer-success queue.
Sam: @Lia thanks. Quick questions: can you paste the minimal prompt you used (not the whole order payload) and the exact request_id (you did — thx). Also any client lib version? streaming + detokenization boundary could be the culprit.
Lia: Minimal prompt in thread above. Client: js-sdk 0.9.1.
Julian: Flagging potential detokenization/escape handling change in v2.3.0 — we rolled in a tokenizer cleanup that touched quote handling. Will check kernel that handles postprocessing for streaming.
Ana: Can you also attach a short dump of the response frames if you have them? Even a few first chunks helps. If it's sensitive DM me the logs or upload to the secure bucket and paste link.
Lia: Pasted first two streaming chunks:
```
chunk1: "\n\"SKU-123\", \\nchunk2: `SKU-124`, \nchunk3: SKU-125"
```
Sam: OK that's very helpful — looks like some chunks include escaped double-quotes while other chunks include backticks. Could be mixing two detokenization paths. I'll repro locally with stream=true and this prompt.
Sam: @Julian can you grep recent commits for anything touching escape_quotes / detokenize_stream? I can try rolling back the postprocess flag on a test instance.
Julian: On it. I see one PR that toggles escape normalization (commit 9f1c4). Rolling back locally now.
Ana: Lia — quick workaround: set `format_hint: "csv"` in the request or set `stream: false` until we patch. That should force the full-text detokenizer and avoid mixed-chunk postprocessing.
Lia: Can confirm switching to stream=false gives correct output. Not ideal for latency but useful as temporary. Thanks.
Sam: I'll open an infra job to run the same workload against v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 with stream=true to confirm delta. Will attach results here. CC @Lia we'll keep you updated.
triage-bot: Follow-up: Eng owner Sam assigned, issue CS-4321 linked to incident rollouts/v2.3.0.
Sam: Next steps: replicate on staging, add unit that simulates chunk boundary with quote tokens, and either revert escape normalization or ensure streaming detokenizer uses same policy as batch path. ETA 24-48h.
Lia: Thanks everyone — please keep me posted. Happy to run more tests on my side. :thumbsup:)
